Aegeon's wife gave birth to identical twin sons at an inn in Epidamnum.
At the same inn, a poor woman gave birth to twin boys, which Aegeon bought to serve as servants for his twin sons.
A violent storm shipwrecked them, splitting their ship on a rock, separating the family into two groups (one set saved by Corinth fishermen, the other by another ship).
